name: Description
author: weam4woo

sections.description: WEAM replaces the default WooCommerce attribute editor with a faster, safer, and more intuitive interface — right inside your existing WooCommerce settings page. If you manage product attributes like Size, Color, Material, or any custom taxonomy, WEAM gives you the tools that make WooCommerce a lot more convenient to use. Documentation | Support | Pro & Pro+ = The problem = The default WooCommerce attribute editor is basic. There’s a basic search but here’s a list of what is missing: – No quick-add – No reordering – No option to set a view per attribute – No protection for empty attributes When your store grows past a handful of attributes, managing them becomes slow and error-prone. = The solution = WEAM adds the features you’d expect from a modern admin tool: type-to-filter, inline editing, smart protection against destructive changes, and per-attribute settings — all without leaving the WooCommerce interface you already know. = Free features = 🔹 Type to filter — instantly find attributes and values in large lists 🔹 Quick Add — add new attribute values inline, paste multiple at once 🔹 Multiple input types — dropdown, radio buttons, or multi-select checkboxes 🔹 Per-attribute settings — configure input type, layout, and sorting per attribute 🔹 Select All / None — bulk selection controls for multi-select attributes 🔹 Show Selected Only — focus on chosen values in long lists 🔹 Maximum selections — limit how many values can be selected per attribute 🔹 Empty field protection — prevents WooCommerce from removing empty attributes on save 🔹 Horizontal & vertical layouts — choose the layout that fits each attribute 🔹 Clean admin UI — streamlined interface that reduces visual clutter 🔹 Lightweight — no bloat, no unnecessary database tables = Pro features = ⚡ Attribute Icons — assign visual icon images to attribute values (swatches, logos, symbols) ⚡ Pixabay integration — search and use free images directly from the editor ⚡ Frontend display — show attribute icons on product pages with shortcodes ⚡ Custom drag & drop ordering — reorder attribute values with drag and drop ⚡ Auto layout — responsive layout that switches between horizontal and vertical automatically ⚡ Import / Export — export and import your WEAM settings across sites ⚡ Help text — add custom instructions per attribute for your editors ⚡ Lock values — prevent unauthorized value changes on specific attributes ⚡ Bulk delete — select and remove multiple attribute values at once ⚡ Lazy load — load terms via AJAX when attribute value count exceeds a threshold ⚡ Product Page settings — configure how attributes appear on product pages = Pro+ features = 🎨 Variant Editor — manage product variations with an improved interface 🎨 Delete Protection — PIN-protected deletion with confirmation workflow 🎨 Audit Trail — track all delete operations with full history 🎨 AI Anomaly Detection — detect data quality issues and inconsistent values across your catalog 🎨 Number Input — integer entry field for numeric attributes (dimensions, quantities) = Works with your setup = ✅ WooCommerce 7.0+ (tested up to 9.5) ✅ WordPress 6.0+ (tested up to 6.9) ✅ PHP 7.4+ ✅ Compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) ✅ Translation ready = Credits = WEAM uses the Pixabay API for image search in the Attribute Icons feature (Pro). Pixabay images are free for commercial use under the Pixabay License.
